data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: activity
sections.summary: Something that a person does for interest, enjoyment, or as part of their job.

senses.definition: something that a person or group does for enjoyment, interest, or as part of a job or routine
examples: Going to the gym is a fun activity to do after work.

answers.answer: Swimming is a popular activity in summer.
Swimming is popular activity in the summer.
She activity every weekend with friends.

sections.question: actor
sections.summary: A person whose job is to perform in plays, films, or television programmes.

senses.definition: a person whose profession is performing in plays, films, or television programmes
examples: The young actor won an award for his debut film role.

answers.answer: The actor performed brilliantly in the film.
The actor played in the film as doctor.
An actor is a place where films are shown.

sections.question: audience
sections.summary: A group of people who watch or listen to a performance, show, or event.

senses.definition: a group of people who have gathered to watch or listen to a performance, speech, or event
examples: The audience was completely silent during the performance.

answers.answer: The audience applauded at the end of the show.
The audiences were very large.
Audience is the person who acts on stage.

sections.question: band
sections.summary: A group of musicians who play together, especially popular or rock music.

senses.definition: a group of musicians who perform together, especially one that plays popular, rock, or jazz music
examples: The band practised together every evening before their concert.

answers.answer: The band played live music at the festival.
The band played a music at festival.
A band is a large art exhibition.

sections.question: collection
sections.summary: A group of objects of the same type that someone has gathered together over time.

senses.definition: a group of objects of the same type that someone has gathered together, often as a hobby
examples: He has an impressive collection of vinyl records.

answers.answer: She has a collection of old coins.
She has collection of old coins.
Collection is a musical performance.

sections.question: concert
sections.summary: A live musical performance given before an audience.

senses.definition: a live musical performance given before an audience, in a venue such as a hall, stadium, or outdoor space
examples: The open-air concert attracted thousands of visitors to the park.

answers.answer: We went to a concert last night.
We went to concert last night.
A concert is a painting in a museum.

sections.question: craft
sections.summary: A skilled activity involving making things by hand, such as knitting, pottery, or weaving.

senses.definition: a skilled activity that involves making things by hand, often as a hobby or traditional art form
examples: Paper folding is a traditional craft that children enjoy.

answers.answer: She enjoys making craft items in her free time.
She enjoys to make crafts in her free time.
Craft is a type of cinema ticket.

sections.question: drama
sections.summary: A type of play, film, or television programme that tells a serious story.

senses.definition: a type of play, film, or television programme that tells a serious or emotional story; also the art of performing or writing plays
examples: She joined the school drama club to improve her acting skills.

answers.answer: He loves watching drama on television.
He loves watching a drama on television every day.
Drama is a sports competition.

sections.question: entertainment
sections.summary: Activities, performances, or shows that provide enjoyment and amusement.

senses.definition: activities, performances, or shows that provide enjoyment, interest, or amusement
examples: The festival provided entertainment for visitors of all ages.

answers.answer: The city offers a lot of entertainment.
The city offers many entertainments.
Entertainment is a museum building.

sections.question: event
sections.summary: Something that happens, especially something planned, important, or unusual.

senses.definition: something that happens, especially a planned occasion or an important or unusual occurrence
examples: The sports event attracted teams from across the country.

answers.answer: The charity event raised a lot of money.
The charity event was very successfully.
An event is a person who visits a museum.
